charts.question: Late deliveries with late handoff
charts.supported_finding: Groups are prioritized using only matured prior-quarter outcomes.
charts.interpretation_boundary: An on-time handoff followed by a late delivery locates delay in the observed sequence. It does not establish fault or show that an intervention prevented lateness.
